Houston, did you know Bob Biggerstaff was a semifinalist on NBC's Last Comic Standing? This hometown hero blends self-deprecating humor with sports tales, making for a night of laughter and relatability. He's graced stages like The Comedy Cellar in NYC and now he's back in town. Catch the show at The Secret Group · Thursday, August 20, 2026. 🎤 Link in bio for tickets. Tag someone you'd bring.

#HoustonComedy #StandUp #LiveComedy #DateNightHouston #ThingsToDoInHouston #BobBiggerstaff

Seen Gabriel Rutledge on Comedy Central’s “Live at Gotham”? 🎤 If not, Houston, you're in for a treat. This Friday, catch his quick wit and relatable humor live at Punch Line. Gabriel's stories about family life and personal mishaps are both hilarious and heartfelt. Straight from his "Don't Read the Comments Tour," he's ready to make you laugh out loud. 

Punch Line Houston · Friday, August 21, 2026

Joey Avery just dropped his debut special, "Live in San Francisco." Houston, you don't want to miss this. Joey's blend of improvised standup and spot-on material has been lighting up stages worldwide. Catch him live and see why he's a favorite on "The Yak" and "Bad Monkey" with Vince Vaughn. The Riot Comedy Club · Friday, August 21, 2026. Link in bio for tickets. Tag someone you'd bring. #HoustonComedy #StandUp #LiveComedy #DateNightHouston #ThingsToDoInHouston #JoeyAvery @joeyavery

Houston, Alfred Robles brings his "Vatos with Gatos" special to life. Known from Comedy Central's "Stand Up Revolution," Alfred's sharp humor and crowd work make every show unique. He’ll have you laughing at everyday life and personal stories. It's like hanging out with a friend who always knows what to say.

Houston Improv · Friday, August 21, 2026

Seen Erin Jackson on "Tiffany Haddish Presents: They Ready"? Houston, she's here live. Erin's comedy is like sharing a laugh with your tell-it-to-you-straight girlfriend. Observational, relatable, and always engaging. Experience her storytelling magic, filled with everyday life and family tales. A night with Erin is a night well spent. 

Punch Line Houston · Sunday, August 23, 2026
